item.title: Over 400 TSA employees quit since shutdown began
item.description: More than 400 Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officers have quit their jobs since the partial government shutdown began on Feb. 14, according to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

item.title: A permanent daylight saving time loophole? Georgia bill may have found one
item.description: Georgia is one of 19 states that have been waiting to lock their clocks on permanent daylight saving time. A new bill could go around the Congressional action they need to make that happen.

item.title: Hundreds of University of Alabama students pack church for James 'Jimmy' Gracey’s memorial mass
